boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Georgia
boards.description: Ten documented food destinations in Athens with late or overnight availability; confirm service details before leaving.

cards.title: Snelling Dining Commons
cards.subtitle: 200 W. Green St., UGA South Campus
cards.notes: Use the late-night window for a campus meal: check the daily dining page, bring an accepted payment method, and allow time before the 2 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: UGA Dining’s South Campus dining commons has a dedicated late-night service period.
cards.evidence_claim: UGA Dining lists Snelling late-night dining Monday through Thursday from 8:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.; it is open to the public and accepts meal plans, Paw Points, cash, credit, and debit.
cards.source_title: Snelling Dining Commons | UGA Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Current listed late-night dining hours: Monday–Thursday, 8:00 p.m.–2:00 a.m. Check the page for closures or special hours.

cards.entity_name: Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers — Baxter St
cards.title: Raising Cane's on Baxter
cards.subtitle: 795 Baxter St., Athens
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, drive-thru, or an order ahead at this Baxter Street location; the official locator lists the same late close for both dining room and drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A Baxter Street chicken-finger restaurant with 3–4 a.m. listed closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists its 795 Baxter St. Athens restaurant’s dine-in and drive-thru hours as until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours: 10:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 10:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday, for dine-in and drive-thru.

cards.title: Eddies Calzones
cards.subtitle: 227 E. Clayton St., downtown Athens
cards.notes: Order food from the restaurant’s downtown location and check the day-specific closing time before heading out; it varies substantially across the week.
cards.short_summary: A downtown calzone restaurant whose posted hours extend past midnight every operating day.
cards.evidence_claim: Eddies Calzones and Drafts lists hours until 2:00 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 1:30 a.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours: Mon–Thu 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.; Fri–Sat 11:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m.; Sun 5:00 p.m.–1:30 a.m.

cards.title: D.P. Dough
cards.subtitle: 180 W. Broad St., Athens
cards.notes: Plan a calzone pickup or delivery from West Broad Street, and use the listed 4 a.m. close as the outer limit rather than assuming immediate service.
cards.short_summary: A West Broad Street calzone destination listed as open nightly until 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Athens lists D.P. Dough at 180 W. Broad St. with hours of 4:00 p.m. to 4:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours: 4:00 p.m.–4:00 a.m., Monday–Sunday. Confirm availability when ordering.

cards.title: Little Italy Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 125 N. Lumpkin St., downtown Athens
cards.notes: Use this North Lumpkin Street stop for pizza, subs, or stromboli; check the calendar because the listing shows Sunday closure and later weekend hours.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizzeria with published closing times from 2 to 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Athens lists Little Italy Pizzeria’s hours until 2:00 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; it is closed Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours: until 2:00 a.m. Mon–Wed and 3:00 a.m. Thu–Sat; closed Sunday.

cards.title: The Grill
cards.subtitle: 171 College Ave., downtown Athens
cards.notes: Head to College Avenue for a late evening meal, especially Thursday through Saturday; the restaurant’s own page distinguishes its midnight nights from regular hours.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue restaurant that explicitly posts midnight service Thursday through Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grill lists hours Tuesday–Sunday from 11:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m., with service until midnight Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Current listed late hours: open until midnight Thursday–Saturday; otherwise listed Tuesday–Sunday until 11:00 p.m.

cards.title: IHOP on Baxter Street
cards.subtitle: 1180 Baxter St., Athens
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check the day before going: it lists midnight closing on Friday and Saturday, with earlier closes on other days.
cards.short_summary: A Baxter Street IHOP whose official location page lists midnight Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 1180 Baxter St. restaurant open until 12:00 a.m. on Friday and Saturday, and until 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: IHOP Late Night Food — 1180 Baxter St
cards.access_notes: Current listed late hours: Friday and Saturday, 7:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. Check the location page for changes.

cards.title: Waffle House Downtown
cards.subtitle: 140 W. Clayton St., downtown Athens
cards.notes: This downtown location is a straightforward any-hour option; use the official locator for directions and verify the store is operating normally before setting out.
cards.short_summary: An official Waffle House locator lists the West Clayton Street restaurant as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House’s Athens location directory lists Waffle House #1936 at 140 W. Clayton St. as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Waffle House Locations in Athens, GA
cards.access_notes: Current listed availability: open 24 hours. Check the official locator for any temporary operating changes.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Broad
cards.subtitle: 2197 W. Broad St., Athens
cards.notes: For the latest run on this list, use the official locator and note the separate drive-thru and dining-room times before choosing how to pick up.
cards.short_summary: A West Broad Street Taco Bell with official listings that run to 4–5 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 2197 W. Broad St. drive-thru open until 4:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 5:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in is listed until 3:00 a.m. on Tuesday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2197 W Broad St, Athens
cards.access_notes: Current listed drive-thru hours: until 4:00 a.m. Sun–Thu and 5:00 a.m. Fri–Sat. The listed dine-in close can differ; verify before departure.

cards.title: Domino's on Lexington Road
cards.subtitle: 2824 Lexington Rd., Athens
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order through the location page, then confirm today’s closing time; its official page currently identifies the Athens store and late availability.
cards.short_summary: An Athens Domino’s location whose official page currently displays availability until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official location page identifies the store at 2824 Lexington Rd., Athens; its current listing shows it open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official store listing currently reports availability until 1:00 a.m. Daily times can change, so confirm before ordering.
